tasks.final_text: I love going ou tto get pizza. There's so many good options and variations that it feels like I can always find something I like and something I'm happy with, regardless of where we go. There are some place that are absolute no goes. Like for example, Pizza Pie Cafe is that absolute worst because of the cheese they use.

The men's singles was a tennis event held as part of the tennis program at the 1904 Summer Olympics. It was the third time the event was held at the Olympics. There were 27 competitors from 2 nations. The event was won by Beals Wright, with the Americans sweeping the medals.
